form:FormGroup.label: To
form:FormGroup.helpText: Email addresses to send the notification to. Separate several addresses with semicolons, e.g. a@example.com; b@example.com. At least one of To, Cc or Bcc must be given.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Separate addresses with semicolons. At least one of To, Cc or Bcc is required.

form:FormGroup.label: Cc
form:FormGroup.helpText: Email addresses to copy the notification to. Separate several addresses with semicolons. Can be left blank if To or Bcc is set.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Separate addresses with semicolons. Can be blank if To or Bcc is set.

form:FormGroup.label: Bcc
form:FormGroup.helpText: Email addresses to send a blind copy to; other recipients cannot see them. Separate several addresses with semicolons. Can be left blank if To or Cc is set.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Hidden from other recipients. Separate addresses with semicolons.

form:FormGroup.label: Email Subject Template
form:FormGroup.helpText: Jinja template for the email subject, e.g. Detector '{{{{ detectorName | escape }}' Alert. It must be a single line and cannot be blank. Select Test Template to see example output.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Jinja template on one line. Required.

form:FormGroup.label: Email Body Template
form:FormGroup.helpText: Jinja template for the email body. If the output contains HTML tags the email is sent as HTML, otherwise as plain text. It cannot be blank; select Test Template to see example output.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Jinja template. Required. Output containing HTML tags is sent as HTML.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Sends one test email to the To, Cc and Bcc recipients, using the current templates and an example detection. You are asked to confirm before it is sent.
